<title level="1" right="Hazard 3" pfs="">[Fiendish Reflection](/Hazards.aspx?ID=429)</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 47

**Complexity** Simple

</column>

Reflections viewed in the water here appear monstrous and fiendish.

---

**Stealth**
DC 23 (expert)

**Disable**
DC 20 [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46) to exorcise the haunt, or DC 23 [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) to turn the fear back on the haunt and overwhelm it

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Frightening Visage** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Trigger** A creature looks at the water; **Effect** The creature sees its reflection on the water's surface distort into a fiendish version of themselves; they must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or become [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 2 (and [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=74) for as long as they remain frightened on a critical failure).

---
**Reset**
The haunt resets immediately and can trigger again the next round.
